pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smoothed edge gradients. Spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the upper mid-flank and decreases in a gradient toward the posterior and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-toned negative space separating patches. Junction nodes are predominantly trifurcate. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder ridge, representing the mane hair silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct dark, vertically-oriented avian silhouettes (likely oxpeckers) positioned on the lateral shoulder and neck transition region.
